notes: Prefix match on `base.hasPrefix("geyser")`/`"floodgate"` is done on the lowercased filename stem (line 546), so "Geyser-Spigot-2.4.0.jar" matches despite the capital G; between two Geyser jars the one with the later `modificationDate` wins (lines 557-567), and a jar with *no* readable mod date is only used `else if geyserURLForSummary == nil` (line 568) -- i.e. it's a last-resort fallback, not a tiebreaker, which is why Floodgate's undated jar here is still picked (it's the only Floodgate candidate) but shows no date suffix (`label(forPath:)`'s no-attrs branch, line 518-519, returns the bare filename). `paperFilename` falls back to `<serverDir>/paper.jar` when `cfgServer.paperJarPath` is empty (lines 525-530), same fallback name as `JavaServerLaunchHelper.resolve`'s.
